# Making log (PRIVATE until reveal). Generated by Grok Bot, 1 Nov 2026. Names: *-rules = condition rules, *-aes = rules + aesthetic module.

Method: for each brief the rules version was made first (core + domain modules, v0.3.1 rule set). The rules+AES version started from the same generation / same file (r0), ran AES-0 intent + diagnosis, made at most two aesthetic changes (AES-10), then re-ran the measured checks. Confound: the AES version always had one extra round of work on top of the rules version, and the maker knew the conditions and wrote the module.
Shared inputs: p05 loaf photo and p11 fox photo used by both versions (one generation each).
